CFML Quick Reference

CFML Quick Reference

Every KoldFusion 4.5 tag and function on one page, for printing and pinning above your monitor. Square brackets mark optional parts; follow a name to its full Language Reference entry.

Tags · Functions · Operators

Tags

Variable manipulation

CFCOOKIE  Sends a cookie to the browser, or deletes one.

<CFCOOKIE NAME="cookie_name"
    VALUE="text"
    EXPIRES="period"
    SECURE="Yes/No"
    PATH="url_path"
    DOMAIN=".domain">

CFPARAM  Checks that a variable exists, optionally gives it a default value and checks its type.

<CFPARAM NAME="param_name"
    DEFAULT="value"
    TYPE="data_type">

CFSET  Creates a variable or changes its value.

<CFSET variable_name = expression>

Flow control

CFABORT  Stops processing the page at the tag, optionally with an error message.

<CFABORT SHOWERROR="error message">

CFBREAK  Leaves the innermost CFLOOP immediately.

<CFBREAK>

CFEXIT  Leaves a custom tag early, or loops back through its end tag.

<CFEXIT METHOD="method">

CFIF/CFELSEIF/CFELSE  Runs a block of code only when an expression is true, with optional alternatives.

<CFIF expression>
  HTML and CFML
<CFELSEIF expression>
  HTML and CFML
<CFELSE>
  HTML and CFML
</CFIF>

CFINCLUDE  Processes another CFML template as if its code were part of the current page.

<CFINCLUDE TEMPLATE="template_name">

CFLOCATION  Sends the browser to another URL and ends the current page.

<CFLOCATION URL="url"
    ADDTOKEN="Yes/No">

CFLOOP  Repeats a block of code: a counted loop, a conditional loop, or a loop over a query, list or structure.

<!--- index loop --->
<CFLOOP INDEX="index_name"
    FROM="start"
    TO="end"
    STEP="increment">
  HTML and CFML
</CFLOOP>

<!--- conditional loop --->
<CFLOOP CONDITION="expression">
  HTML and CFML
</CFLOOP>

<!--- query loop --->
<CFLOOP QUERY="query_name"
    STARTROW="row_num"
    ENDROW="row_num">
  HTML and CFML
</CFLOOP>

<!--- list loop --->
<CFLOOP INDEX="index_name"
    LIST="list_items"
    DELIMITERS="item_delimiter">
  HTML and CFML
</CFLOOP>

<!--- collection loop --->
<CFLOOP COLLECTION="#structure#"
    ITEM="key_name">
  HTML and CFML
</CFLOOP>

CFSCRIPT  Encloses a block of script code written in the JavaScript-like CFScript language.

<CFSCRIPT>
  statements
</CFSCRIPT>

CFSWITCH/CFCASE/CFDEFAULTCASE  Chooses one of several blocks of code by comparing an expression with a list of values.

<CFSWITCH EXPRESSION="#expression#">
  <CFCASE VALUE="value" DELIMITERS=",">
    HTML and CFML
  </CFCASE>
  <CFCASE VALUE="value1,value2">
    HTML and CFML
  </CFCASE>
  <CFDEFAULTCASE>
    HTML and CFML
  </CFDEFAULTCASE>
</CFSWITCH>

Exception handling

CFERROR  Names a template to show instead of the standard error message when a page fails.

<CFERROR TYPE="Request/Exception/Validation/Monitor"
    TEMPLATE="template_path"
    MAILTO="email_address"
    EXCEPTION="exception_type">

CFRETHROW  Raises the current exception again from inside a CFCATCH block.

<CFRETHROW>

CFTHROW  Raises a custom error that can be caught with CFTRY/CFCATCH.

<CFTHROW TYPE="exception_type"
    MESSAGE="message"
    DETAIL="detail_description"
    ERRORCODE="error_code"
    EXTENDEDINFO="additional_information">

CFTRY/CFCATCH  Catches errors raised inside a block of code and handles them with your own code.

<CFTRY>
  code that may raise an error
  <CFCATCH TYPE="exception_type">
    code that handles the error
  </CFCATCH>
  <CFCATCH TYPE="Any">
    code that handles any other error
  </CFCATCH>
</CFTRY>

Output and page processing

CFCACHE  Saves the generated page to a file and serves that copy to later visitors.

<CFCACHE ACTION="CACHE/FLUSH/CLIENTCACHE/OPTIMAL"
    DIRECTORY="directory"
    TIMEOUT="date_time"
    EXPIREURL="url"
    PROTOCOL="http://"
    PORT="port"
    USERNAME="username"
    PASSWORD="password">

CFCOL  Defines one column of a CFTABLE.

<CFCOL HEADER="column_header"
    WIDTH="number_of_characters"
    ALIGN="Left/Right/Center"
    TEXT="#column_text#">

CFCONTENT  Sets the MIME type of the response and optionally sends a file instead of the page.

<CFCONTENT TYPE="file_type"
    FILE="filename"
    DELETEFILE="Yes/No"
    RESET="Yes/No">

CFHEADER  Adds an HTTP header to the response or sets the HTTP status code.

<CFHEADER NAME="header_name"
    VALUE="header_value">

<CFHEADER STATUSCODE="status_code"
    STATUSTEXT="status_text">

CFHTMLHEAD  Writes text into the HEAD section of the page being generated.

<CFHTMLHEAD TEXT="text">

CFOUTPUT  Evaluates the #expressions# in its body and writes the result, optionally once per query row or group.

<CFOUTPUT QUERY="query_name"
    GROUP="column[,column]"
    GROUPCASESENSITIVE="Yes/No"
    STARTROW="start_row"
    MAXROWS="max_rows_output">
  Literal text, HTML and #expressions#
</CFOUTPUT>

CFPROCESSINGDIRECTIVE  Compresses runs of whitespace in the output generated by its body.

<CFPROCESSINGDIRECTIVE SUPPRESSWHITESPACE="Yes/No">
  CFML and HTML
</CFPROCESSINGDIRECTIVE>

CFSETTING  Controls page-level processing settings such as output outside CFOUTPUT and debug output.

<CFSETTING ENABLECFOUTPUTONLY="Yes/No"
    SHOWDEBUGOUTPUT="Yes/No"
    CATCHEXCEPTIONSBYPATTERN="Yes/No">

CFSILENT  Runs the CFML in its body but throws away all the output it generates.

<CFSILENT>
  CFML whose output is discarded
</CFSILENT>

CFTABLE  Builds a table from a query, either as preformatted text or as an HTML table.

<CFTABLE QUERY="query_name"
    MAXROWS="max_rows"
    COLSPACING="number_of_spaces"
    HEADERLINES="number_of_lines"
    HTMLTABLE
    BORDER
    COLHEADERS
    STARTROW="row">
  <CFCOL ...>
</CFTABLE>

Database manipulation

CFINSERT  Inserts the fields of a submitted form as a new row of a table, without writing any SQL.

<CFINSERT DATASOURCE="ds_name"
    TABLENAME="table_name"
    TABLEOWNER="owner"
    TABLEQUALIFIER="qualifier"
    USERNAME="username"
    PASSWORD="password"
    FORMFIELDS="field_names">

CFPROCPARAM  Passes one parameter to a stored procedure called with CFSTOREDPROC.

<CFPROCPARAM TYPE="In/Out/InOut"
    VARIABLE="variable_name"
    DBVARNAME="db_variable_name"
    VALUE="parameter_value"
    CFSQLTYPE="parameter_datatype"
    MAXLENGTH="length"
    SCALE="decimal_places"
    NULL="Yes/No">

CFPROCRESULT  Names a result set returned by a stored procedure called with CFSTOREDPROC.

<CFPROCRESULT NAME="query_name"
    RESULTSET="1-n"
    MAXROWS="maxrows">

CFQUERY  Passes SQL statements to a data source and returns the result set as a query.

<CFQUERY NAME="query_name"
    DATASOURCE="ds_name"
    DBTYPE="ODBC"
    MAXROWS="number"
    CACHEDWITHIN="timespan"
    CACHEDAFTER="date">
  SQL statements
</CFQUERY>

CFQUERYPARAM  Binds a typed, validated value into the SQL of a CFQUERY.

<CFQUERYPARAM VALUE="parameter_value"
    CFSQLTYPE="parameter_type"
    MAXLENGTH="maximum_length"
    SCALE="decimal_places"
    NULL="Yes/No">

CFSTOREDPROC  Calls a stored procedure in a database server.

<CFSTOREDPROC PROCEDURE="procedure_name"
    DATASOURCE="ds_name"
    USERNAME="username"
    PASSWORD="password"
    DBSERVER="dbms"
    DBNAME="database_name"
    BLOCKFACTOR="blocksize"
    PROVIDER="COMProvider"
    PROVIDERDSN="datasource"
    DEBUG="Yes/No"
    RETURNCODE="Yes/No">
  CFPROCPARAM and CFPROCRESULT tags
</CFSTOREDPROC>

CFTRANSACTION  Groups several CFQUERY operations into a single database transaction.

<CFTRANSACTION ACTION="BEGIN"
    ISOLATION="lock_level">
  CFQUERY tags
</CFTRANSACTION>

CFUPDATE  Updates an existing table row from the fields of a submitted form, without writing any SQL.

<CFUPDATE DATASOURCE="ds_name"
    TABLENAME="table_name"
    TABLEOWNER="owner"
    TABLEQUALIFIER="qualifier"
    USERNAME="username"
    PASSWORD="password"
    FORMFIELDS="field_names">

Application framework

CFAPPLICATION  Names the application and switches on application, session and client variables.

<CFAPPLICATION NAME="application_name"
    CLIENTMANAGEMENT="Yes/No"
    CLIENTSTORAGE="Registry/Cookie/datasource_name"
    SETCLIENTCOOKIES="Yes/No"
    SETDOMAINCOOKIES="Yes/No"
    SESSIONMANAGEMENT="Yes/No"
    SESSIONTIMEOUT="#CreateTimeSpan(days, hours, minutes, seconds)#"
    APPLICATIONTIMEOUT="#CreateTimeSpan(days, hours, minutes, seconds)#">

CFLOCK  Makes sure only one request at a time runs a block of code (or only readers run it together).

<CFLOCK SCOPE="Application/Session/Server"
    NAME="lock_name"
    TIMEOUT="seconds"
    TYPE="ReadOnly/Exclusive"
    THROWONTIMEOUT="Yes/No">
  CFML
</CFLOCK>

Extensibility

CFASSOCIATE  Lets a nested custom tag pass its attributes to an ancestor custom tag.

<CFASSOCIATE BASETAG="CF_TAGNAME"
    DATACOLLECTION="collection_name">

CFMODULE  Calls a custom tag by template path or by name.

<CFMODULE TEMPLATE="path"
    NAME="tag_name"
    ATTRIBUTECOLLECTION="structure"
    attribute_name="value" ...>
  [body]
[</CFMODULE>]

CFOBJECT  Creates a COM, CORBA or Java object. Not available in KoldFusion for UNIX.

<CFOBJECT TYPE="COM/CORBA/JAVA"
    ACTION="Create/Connect"
    CLASS="program_id"
    NAME="object_name"
    CONTEXT="InProc/Local/Remote/IOR/NameService"
    SERVER="server_name"
    LOCALE="locale">

CFREPORT  Runs a Crystal Reports report. Not available in KoldFusion for UNIX.

<CFREPORT REPORT="report_path"
    ORDERBY="result_order"
    USERNAME="username"
    PASSWORD="password"
    FORMULA="formula">
  optional record selection formula
</CFREPORT>

CFSERVLET  Runs a Java servlet on a JRun servlet engine and returns its output. Not available in KoldFusion.

<CFSERVLET CODE="class_name_of_servlet"
    JRUNPROXY="proxy_server"
    TIMEOUT="seconds"
    WRITEOUTPUT="Yes/No"
    DEBUG="Yes/No">
  <CFSERVLETPARAM ...>
</CFSERVLET>

CFSERVLETPARAM  Passes a parameter to the servlet called by CFSERVLET.

<CFSERVLETPARAM NAME="parameter_name"
    VALUE="value">

<CFSERVLETPARAM NAME="servlet_attribute_name"
    VARIABLE="variable_name"
    TYPE="INT/DOUBLE/BOOL/DATE/STRING">

CFX Tags (CFX_HELLO, CFX_DICE, CFX_SYSINFO)  Sample CFX tags (compiled C extensions) that ship with KoldFusion: a greeting, a dice roller and a system query.

<CFX_HELLO NAME="name"
    VARIABLE="variable_name"
    DEBUG>

<CFX_DICE ROLLS="number"
    SIDES="number"
    VARIABLE="variable_name">

<CFX_SYSINFO NAME="query_name">

Internet protocols

CFFTP  Opens an FTP connection and lists, transfers, renames and deletes files on the remote server.

<CFFTP ACTION="action"
    SERVER="server"
    USERNAME="username"
    PASSWORD="password"
    PORT="port"
    CONNECTION="name"
    TIMEOUT="seconds"
    STOPONERROR="Yes/No"
    DIRECTORY="directory"
    NAME="query_name"
    LOCALFILE="local_path"
    REMOTEFILE="remote_name"
    ITEM="item"
    EXISTING="old_name"
    NEW="new_name"
    FAILIFEXISTS="Yes/No"
    TRANSFERMODE="Binary"
    PASSIVE="Yes"
    PROXYSERVER="proxyserver"
    RETRYCOUNT="number"
    AGENTNAME="name">

CFHTTP  Fetches a page or file from a Web server with an HTTP GET or POST.

<CFHTTP URL="hostname"
    METHOD="GET/POST"
    USERNAME="username"
    PASSWORD="password"
    NAME="queryname"
    COLUMNS="column_names"
    PATH="path"
    FILE="filename"
    DELIMITER="character"
    TEXTQUALIFIER="character"
    RESOLVEURL="Yes/No"
    PROXYSERVER="hostname"
    PROXYPORT="port_number"
    PORT="port_number"
    TIMEOUT="seconds"
    THROWONERROR="Yes/No">
  CFHTTPPARAM tags (for POST)
</CFHTTP>

CFHTTPPARAM  Adds a URL parameter, form field, cookie, header or file to a CFHTTP request.

<CFHTTPPARAM TYPE="type"
    NAME="name"
    VALUE="transaction_name"
    FILE="filename">

CFLDAP  Queries and updates an LDAP directory server.

<CFLDAP SERVER="server_name"
    PORT="port_number"
    USERNAME="name"
    PASSWORD="password"
    ACTION="action"
    NAME="name"
    TIMEOUT="seconds"
    MAXROWS="number"
    START="distinguished_name"
    SCOPE="scope"
    ATTRIBUTES="attribute, attribute"
    FILTER="filter"
    SORT="attribute[, attribute]..."
    DN="distinguished_name"
    STARTROW="row_number"
    MODIFYTYPE="replace">

CFMAIL  Sends an e-mail message, or one message per row or group of a query.

<CFMAIL TO="recipient"
    FROM="sender"
    CC="copy_to"
    BCC="blind_copy_to"
    SUBJECT="msg_subject"
    TYPE="HTML"
    MAXROWS="max_msgs"
    MIMEATTACH="path"
    QUERY="query_name"
    GROUP="query_column"
    STARTROW="query_row"
    SERVER="servername"
    PORT="port_ID"
    MAILERID="headerid"
    TIMEOUT="seconds">
  message text
</CFMAIL>

CFMAILPARAM  Attaches a file or adds a custom header to a message sent with CFMAIL.

<CFMAILPARAM FILE="file_name">
  or
<CFMAILPARAM NAME="header_name"
    VALUE="header_value">

CFPOP  Retrieves or deletes messages in a POP3 mailbox.

<CFPOP SERVER="servername"
    PORT="port_number"
    USERNAME="username"
    PASSWORD="password"
    ACTION="action"
    NAME="query_name"
    MESSAGENUMBER="number"
    ATTACHMENTPATH="path"
    TIMEOUT="seconds"
    MAXROWS="number"
    STARTROW="number">

File, directory and system

CFDIRECTORY  Lists, creates, renames and deletes directories on the server.

<CFDIRECTORY ACTION="directory_action"
    DIRECTORY="full_path_name"
    NAME="query_name"
    FILTER="list_filter"
    SORT="sort_specification"
    MODE="permission"
    NEWDIRECTORY="new_directory_name">

CFEXECUTE  Runs a program on the server and captures what it prints.

<CFEXECUTE NAME="application_name"
    ARGUMENTS="command_line_arguments"
    OUTPUTFILE="output_file_name"
    TIMEOUT="timeout_in_seconds">
</CFEXECUTE>

CFFILE  Uploads, reads, writes, copies, moves, renames and deletes files on the server.

<CFFILE ACTION="UPLOAD"
    FILEFIELD="formfield"
    DESTINATION="full_path_name"
    NAMECONFLICT="behavior"
    ACCEPT="mime_type/file_type"
    MODE="permission"
    ATTRIBUTES="file_attributes">

<CFFILE ACTION="READ" FILE="full_path_name" VARIABLE="var_name">
<CFFILE ACTION="READBINARY" FILE="full_path_name" VARIABLE="var_name">
<CFFILE ACTION="WRITE" FILE="full_path_name" OUTPUT="content"
    ADDNEWLINE="Yes/No" MODE="permission" ATTRIBUTES="file_attributes">
<CFFILE ACTION="APPEND" FILE="full_path_name" OUTPUT="content"
    ADDNEWLINE="Yes/No" MODE="permission" ATTRIBUTES="file_attributes">
<CFFILE ACTION="COPY" SOURCE="full_path_name" DESTINATION="full_path_name">
<CFFILE ACTION="MOVE" SOURCE="full_path_name" DESTINATION="full_path_name">
<CFFILE ACTION="RENAME" SOURCE="full_path_name" DESTINATION="full_path_name">
<CFFILE ACTION="DELETE" FILE="full_path_name">

CFREGISTRY  Reads, writes and deletes keys and values in the system registry.

<CFREGISTRY ACTION="GetAll" BRANCH="branch" NAME="query_name" TYPE="data_type" SORT="criteria">
<CFREGISTRY ACTION="Get" BRANCH="branch" ENTRY="key_or_value" VARIABLE="variable" TYPE="data_type">
<CFREGISTRY ACTION="Set" BRANCH="branch" ENTRY="key_or_value" TYPE="value_type" VALUE="data">
<CFREGISTRY ACTION="Delete" BRANCH="branch" ENTRY="key_or_value">

CFSCHEDULE  Creates, updates, deletes and runs tasks in the KoldFusion scheduler.

<CFSCHEDULE ACTION="Update"
    TASK="taskname"
    OPERATION="HTTPRequest"
    URL="URL"
    STARTDATE="date"
    STARTTIME="time"
    INTERVAL="seconds"
    ENDDATE="date"
    ENDTIME="time"
    REQUESTTIMEOUT="seconds"
    USERNAME="username"
    PASSWORD="password"
    PROXYSERVER="hostname"
    PUBLISH="Yes/No"
    PATH="path_to_file"
    FILE="filename"
    RESOLVEURL="Yes/No">

<CFSCHEDULE ACTION="Delete" TASK="taskname">
<CFSCHEDULE ACTION="Run" TASK="taskname">

Data interchange

CFWDDX  Converts CFML data to and from WDDX packets, and to JavaScript.

<CFWDDX ACTION="action"
    INPUT="inputdata"
    OUTPUT="resultvariable"
    TOPLEVELVARIABLE="toplevelvariablenameforjavascript"
    USETIMEZONEINFO="Yes/No">

Verity search

CFCOLLECTION  Creates, maps, repairs, optimizes or deletes a Verity search collection.

<CFCOLLECTION ACTION="action"
    COLLECTION="collection_name"
    PATH="directory"
    LANGUAGE="English">

CFINDEX  Adds documents, files or query rows to a Verity collection, or removes them.

<CFINDEX COLLECTION="collection_name"
    ACTION="action"
    TYPE="type"
    KEY="key"
    TITLE="title"
    BODY="body"
    CUSTOM1="value"
    CUSTOM2="value"
    URLPATH="URL"
    EXTENSIONS="file_extensions"
    QUERY="query_name"
    RECURSE="Yes/No"
    EXTERNAL="Yes/No"
    LANGUAGE="English">

CFSEARCH  Searches one or more Verity collections and returns the matches as a query.

<CFSEARCH NAME="search_name"
    COLLECTION="collection_name"
    TYPE="SIMPLE"
    CRITERIA="search_expression"
    MAXROWS="number"
    STARTROW="row_number"
    EXTERNAL="Yes/No"
    LANGUAGE="English">

Security

CFAUTHENTICATE  Logs a user in to a security context of Advanced Security.

<CFAUTHENTICATE SECURITYCONTEXT="context"
    USERNAME="user_ID"
    PASSWORD="password"
    SETCOOKIE="Yes/No"
    THROWONFAILURE="Yes/No">

CFIMPERSONATE  Runs a block of code as another user of a security context.

<CFIMPERSONATE SECURITYCONTEXT="context"
    USERNAME="user_ID"
    PASSWORD="password"
    TYPE="CF/OS"
    LOGIN="domain">
  code that runs as that user
</CFIMPERSONATE>

Forms

CFAPPLET  Embeds a Java applet registered in the Administrator into a CFFORM.

<CFAPPLET APPLETSOURCE="applet_name"
    NAME="form_variable_name"
    HEIGHT="pixels"
    WIDTH="pixels"
    VSPACE="pixels"
    HSPACE="pixels"
    ALIGN="alignment"
    NOTSUPPORTED="text"
    param_1="value"
    param_n="value">

CFFORM  Builds an HTML form with automatic JavaScript input validation.

<CFFORM NAME="name"
    ACTION="form_action"
    METHOD="POST"
    TARGET="window_name"
    ENCTYPE="type"
    ONSUBMIT="javascript"
    PRESERVEDATA="Yes/No"
    ENABLECAB="Yes/No"
    PASSTHROUGH="HTML_attributes">
  form controls
</CFFORM>

CFGRID  Displays query data in a grid that users can browse, follow links from or edit.

<CFGRID NAME="name"
    QUERY="query_name"
    SELECTMODE="mode"
    INSERT="Yes/No"
    DELETE="Yes/No"
    HREF="URL"
    HREFKEY="column_name"
    APPENDKEY="Yes/No"
    TARGET="window_name"
    FONT="font_name"
    WIDTH="width"
    HEIGHT="pixels"
    MAXROWS="number"
    SORT="Yes/No"
    BGCOLOR="color"
    NOTSUPPORTED="text">
  CFGRIDCOLUMN and CFGRIDROW tags
</CFGRID>

CFGRIDCOLUMN  Defines one column of a CFGRID.

<CFGRIDCOLUMN NAME="column_name"
    HEADER="header"
    WIDTH="pixels"
    DATAALIGN="Left/Center/Right"
    DISPLAY="Yes/No"
    SELECT="Yes/No"
    HREF="URL"
    HREFKEY="column_name"
    TARGET="window_name"
    NUMBERFORMAT="format"
    TYPE="type">

CFGRIDROW  Adds one row of literal data to a CFGRID that has no query.

<CFGRIDROW DATA="value1, value2, ...">

CFGRIDUPDATE  Writes the edits made in a CFGRID back to a database table.

<CFGRIDUPDATE GRID="grid_name"
    DATASOURCE="ds_name"
    TABLENAME="table_name"
    KEYONLY="Yes/No"
    DBTYPE="type"
    USERNAME="user"
    PASSWORD="password"
    TABLEOWNER="owner"
    TABLEQUALIFIER="qualifier">

CFINPUT  Creates a text, password, radio button or check box control with client-side validation.

<CFINPUT TYPE="input_type"
    NAME="name"
    VALUE="initial_value"
    REQUIRED="Yes/No"
    VALIDATE="data_type"
    RANGE="min_value,max_value"
    ONVALIDATE="javascript_function"
    MESSAGE="validation_message"
    ONERROR="javascript_function"
    SIZE="integer"
    MAXLENGTH="integer"
    CHECKED="Yes/No"
    PASSTHROUGH="HTML_attributes">

CFSELECT  Creates a drop-down list or list box, optionally filled from a query.

<CFSELECT NAME="name"
    SIZE="integer"
    MULTIPLE="Yes/No"
    REQUIRED="Yes/No"
    MESSAGE="text"
    ONERROR="javascript_function"
    QUERY="query_name"
    VALUE="column_name"
    DISPLAY="column_name"
    SELECTED="value_list"
    PASSTHROUGH="HTML_attributes">
  optional OPTION tags
</CFSELECT>

CFSLIDER  Creates a control for picking a number from a range.

<CFSLIDER NAME="name"
    LABEL="text"
    RANGE="min_value,max_value"
    SCALE="increment"
    VALUE="integer"
    BGCOLOR="color"
    REFRESHLABEL="Yes/No"
    IMG="filename"
    IMGSTYLE="style"
    GROOVECOLOR="color"
    TEXTCOLOR="color"
    FONT="font_name"
    FONTSIZE="integer"
    ITALIC="Yes/No"
    BOLD="Yes/No"
    HEIGHT="pixels"
    WIDTH="pixels"
    VSPACE="pixels"
    HSPACE="pixels"
    ALIGN="alignment"
    ONVALIDATE="javascript_function"
    MESSAGE="text"
    ONERROR="javascript_function"
    NOTSUPPORTED="text">

CFTEXTINPUT  Creates a styled single-line text entry control with validation.

<CFTEXTINPUT NAME="name"
    VALUE="text"
    REQUIRED="Yes/No"
    VALIDATE="data_type"
    RANGE="min_value,max_value"
    ONVALIDATE="javascript_function"
    MESSAGE="text"
    ONERROR="javascript_function"
    SIZE="integer"
    MAXLENGTH="integer"
    FONT="font_name"
    FONTSIZE="integer"
    BOLD="Yes/No"
    ITALIC="Yes/No"
    BGCOLOR="color"
    TEXTCOLOR="color"
    HEIGHT="pixels"
    WIDTH="pixels"
    VSPACE="pixels"
    HSPACE="pixels"
    ALIGN="alignment"
    NOTSUPPORTED="text">

CFTREE  Displays a hierarchical tree of items the user can expand, collapse and select.

<CFTREE NAME="name"
    REQUIRED="Yes/No"
    MESSAGE="text"
    FONT="font_name"
    WIDTH="pixels"
    DELIMITER="delimiter"
    COMPLETEPATH="Yes/No"
    APPENDKEY="Yes/No"
    HIGHLIGHTHREF="Yes/No"
    ONVALIDATE="javascript_function"
    ONERROR="javascript_function"
    FONTSIZE="integer"
    ITALIC="Yes/No"
    BOLD="Yes/No"
    HEIGHT="pixels"
    BORDER="Yes/No"
    HSCROLL="Yes/No"
    VSCROLL="Yes/No"
    NOTSUPPORTED="text">
  CFTREEITEM tags
</CFTREE>

CFTREEITEM  Adds an item, or a whole branch built from a query, to a CFTREE.

<CFTREEITEM VALUE="text"
    DISPLAY="text"
    PARENT="parent_value"
    IMG="image"
    IMGOPEN="image"
    HREF="URL"
    TARGET="window_name"
    EXPAND="Yes/No"
    QUERY="query_name"
    QUERYASROOT="Yes/No">

Functions

Array functions

ArrayAppend(array, value)Adds an element to the end of an array.
ArrayAvg(array)Returns the average of the values in a numeric array.
ArrayClear(array)Removes all elements from an array.
ArrayDeleteAt(array, position)Deletes an element from an array and closes the gap.
ArrayInsertAt(array, position, value)Inserts a value into an array at a given position.
ArrayIsEmpty(array)Determines whether an array has no elements.
ArrayLen(array)Returns the number of elements in an array.
ArrayMax(array)Returns the largest number in an array.
ArrayMin(array)Returns the smallest number in an array.
ArrayNew(dimension)Creates an empty array of one, two or three dimensions.
ArrayPrepend(array, value)Adds an element to the beginning of an array.
ArrayResize(array, minimum_size)Makes an array at least a given number of elements long.
ArraySet(array, start_pos, end_pos, value)Sets a range of array elements to the same value.
ArraySort(array, sort_type [, sort_order ])Sorts the elements of an array in place.
ArraySum(array)Returns the sum of the values in a numeric array.
ArraySwap(array, position1, position2)Swaps two elements of an array.
ArrayToList(array [, delimiter ])Converts a one-dimensional array to a delimited list.

Authentication functions

AuthenticatedContext()Returns the name of the security context the user authenticated in.
AuthenticatedUser()Returns the name of the user authenticated by CFAUTHENTICATE.
IsAuthenticated([ securitycontext ])Returns YES if the visitor has been authenticated by CFAUTHENTICATE.
IsAuthorized(resourcetype, resourcename [, action ])Returns YES if the authenticated user may perform an action on a resource.
IsProtected(resourcetype, resourcename [, action ])Returns YES if a resource is covered by an Advanced Security rule.

Date and time functions

CreateDate(year, month, day)Returns a date/time value for a year, month and day.
CreateDateTime(year, month, day, hour, minute, second)Returns a date/time value for a year, month, day, hour, minute and second.
CreateODBCDate(date)Returns a date in ODBC date format, {d 'yyyy-mm-dd'}.
CreateODBCDateTime(date)Returns a date/time in ODBC timestamp format, {ts 'yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss'}.
CreateODBCTime(date)Returns a time in ODBC time format, {t 'hh:mm:ss'}.
CreateTime(hour, minute, second)Returns a date/time value for an hour, minute and second.
CreateTimeSpan(days, hours, minutes, seconds)Returns a time span (a number of days) for use with date arithmetic and query caching.
DateAdd(datepart, number, date)Adds a number of years, months, days, hours, etc. to a date.
DateCompare(date1, date2 [, datePart ])Compares two dates and returns -1, 0 or 1.
DateConvert(conversionType, date)Converts a date/time between local time and Coordinated Universal Time (UTC).
DateDiff(datepart, date1, date2)Returns the number of whole units (years, days, hours, ...) between two dates.
DatePart(datepart, date)Returns one part (year, month, weekday, hour, ...) of a date as a number.
Day(date)Returns the day of the month (1-31) of a date.
DayOfWeek(date)Returns the day of the week (1 = Sunday to 7 = Saturday) of a date.
DayOfWeekAsString(day_of_week)Returns the name of a weekday (1 = Sunday) as a string.
DayOfYear(date)Returns the day of the year (1-366) of a date.
DaysInMonth(date)Returns the number of days in the month of a date.
DaysInYear(date)Returns the number of days (365 or 366) in the year of a date.
FirstDayOfMonth(date)Returns the day of the year on which the month of a date begins.
GetHTTPTimeString([ date ])Formats a date/time as a GMT string for HTTP headers.
GetTimeZoneInfo()Returns a structure describing the server's time zone.
Hour(date)Returns the hour (0-23) of a date/time.
IsLeapYear(year)Returns YES if a year is a leap year.
Minute(date)Returns the minute (0-59) of a date/time.
Month(date)Returns the month (1-12) of a date.
MonthAsString(month_number)Returns the name of a month (1 = January) as a string.
Now()Returns the current date and time of the server.
ParseDateTime(date_string [, pop_conversion_method ])Converts a date/time string into a date/time value.
Quarter(date)Returns the quarter of the year (1-4) of a date.
Second(date)Returns the second (0-59) of a date/time.
Week(date)Returns the week of the year (1-53) of a date.
Year(date)Returns the year of a date, always with four digits.

Decision functions

IsArray(value [, number ])Determines whether a value is an array, optionally of a given dimension.
IsBinary(value)Determines whether a value is binary data.
IsBoolean(value)Determines whether a value can be converted to a Boolean.
IsDate(string)Determines whether a string can be converted to a date/time value.
IsDebugMode()Determines whether debugging output is turned on for the current page.
IsDefined("variable_name")Determines whether a variable with the given name exists.
IsNumeric(string)Determines whether a string can be converted to a number.
IsNumericDate(number)Determines whether a value is a number that can be used as a date/time value.
IsQuery(value)Determines whether a value is a query.
IsSimpleValue(value)Determines whether a value is a simple value (string, number, Boolean or date).
IsStruct(value)Determines whether a value is a structure.
IsWDDX(value)Determines whether a string is a WDDX packet.
ParameterExists(variable_name)Determines whether a variable exists (obsolete; use IsDefined).

Display and formatting functions

DateFormat(date [, mask ])Formats the date part of a date/time value using a mask.
DecimalFormat(number)Formats a number with two decimal places and thousands separators.
DollarFormat(number)Formats a number as a U.S. dollar amount.
HTMLCodeFormat(string [, version ])Escapes HTML special characters and wraps the result in PRE tags.
HTMLEditFormat(string [, version ])Escapes HTML special characters so text displays literally.
NumberFormat(number [, mask ])Formats a number using a mask.
ParagraphFormat(string)Turns blank lines in plain text into HTML paragraph breaks.
TimeFormat(time [, mask ])Formats the time part of a date/time value using a mask.
YesNoFormat(value)Displays a boolean value as Yes or No.

Dynamic evaluation functions

DE(string)Wraps a string in double quotes so that a later evaluation returns it unchanged.
Evaluate(string_expression1 [, string_expression2 [, ... ] ])Evaluates one or more strings as CFML expressions and returns the last result.
IIf(condition, string_expression1, string_expression2)Picks one of two string expressions based on a condition and evaluates it.
SetVariable(name, value)Assigns a value to a variable whose name is given as a string.

International functions

GetLocale()Returns the name of the current locale.
LSCurrencyFormat(number [, type ])Formats a number as money for the current locale.
LSDateFormat(date [, mask ])Formats the date part of a date/time value for the current locale.
LSEuroCurrencyFormat(currency [, type ])Formats a number as an amount in euros.
LSIsCurrency(string)Tests whether a string is a currency amount in the current locale.
LSIsDate(string)Tests whether a string is a date/time value in the current locale.
LSIsNumeric(string)Tests whether a string is a number in the current locale.
LSNumberFormat(number [, mask ])Formats a number using a mask, for the current locale.
LSParseCurrency(string)Converts a currency string in the current locale to a number.
LSParseDateTime(date_string)Converts a date/time string in the current locale to a date/time value.
LSParseEuroCurrency(string)Converts a euro currency string to a number.
LSParseNumber(string)Converts a numeric string in the current locale to a number.
LSTimeFormat(time [, mask ])Formats the time part of a date/time value for the current locale.
SetLocale(new_locale)Sets the locale used by the LS functions and returns the previous one.

List functions

ListAppend(list, value [, delimiters ])Adds an element to the end of a list.
ListChangeDelims(list, new_delimiter [, delimiters ])Changes the delimiters of a list.
ListContains(list, substring [, delimiters ])Finds the first list element that contains a substring (case-sensitive).
ListContainsNoCase(list, substring [, delimiters ])Finds the first list element that contains a substring, ignoring case.
ListDeleteAt(list, position [, delimiters ])Removes the element at a given position from a list.
ListFind(list, value [, delimiters ])Finds an element in a list (case-sensitive).
ListFindNoCase(list, value [, delimiters ])Finds an element in a list, ignoring case.
ListFirst(list [, delimiters ])Returns the first element of a list.
ListGetAt(list, position [, delimiters ])Returns the element at a given position in a list.
ListInsertAt(list, position, value [, delimiters ])Inserts an element into a list at a given position.
ListLast(list [, delimiters ])Returns the last element of a list.
ListLen(list [, delimiters ])Returns the number of elements in a list.
ListPrepend(list, value [, delimiters ])Adds an element to the beginning of a list.
ListQualify(list, qualifier [, delimiters ] [, elements ])Puts a qualifier, such as quotes, around each element of a list.
ListRest(list [, delimiters ])Returns a list without its first element.
ListSetAt(list, position, value [, delimiters ])Replaces the element at a given position in a list.
ListSort(list, sort_type [, sort_order ] [, delimiters ])Sorts the elements of a list.
ListToArray(list [, delimiters ])Converts a list to a one-dimensional array.
ListValueCount(list, value [, delimiters ])Counts how many list elements equal a value (case-sensitive).
ListValueCountNoCase(list, value [, delimiters ])Counts how many list elements equal a value, ignoring case.

Mathematical functions

Abs(number)Returns the absolute value of a number.
ACos(number)Returns the arccosine of a number, in radians.
ASin(number)Returns the arcsine of a number, in radians.
Atn(number)Returns the arctangent of a number, in radians.
BitAnd(number1, number2)Performs a bitwise logical AND of two integers.
BitMaskClear(number, start, length)Clears a run of bits in an integer.
BitMaskRead(number, start, length)Reads a run of bits from an integer.
BitMaskSet(number, mask, start, length)Writes a value into a run of bits of an integer.
BitNot(number)Performs a bitwise logical NOT (one's complement) of an integer.
BitOr(number1, number2)Performs a bitwise logical OR of two integers.
BitSHLN(number, count)Shifts the bits of an integer to the left.
BitSHRN(number, count)Shifts the bits of an integer to the right.
BitXor(number1, number2)Performs a bitwise logical exclusive OR of two integers.
Ceiling(number)Returns the smallest integer greater than or equal to a number.
Cos(number)Returns the cosine of an angle given in radians.
DecrementValue(number)Returns the integer part of a number, decreased by one.
Exp(number)Returns e raised to a power.
Fix(number)Removes the fractional part of a number, rounding toward zero.
FormatBaseN(number, radix)Converts a number to a string in a given base (radix).
IncrementValue(number)Returns the integer part of a number, increased by one.
InputBaseN(string, radix)Converts a string in a given base (radix) to a decimal integer.
Int(number)Returns the largest integer less than or equal to a number.
Log(number)Returns the natural logarithm of a number.
Log10(number)Returns the base-10 logarithm of a number.
Max(number1, number2)Returns the larger of two numbers.
Min(number1, number2)Returns the smaller of two numbers.
Pi()Returns the constant pi.
Rand()Returns a random number between 0 and 1.
Randomize(number)Seeds the random number generator.
RandRange(number1, number2)Returns a random integer in a range.
Round(number)Rounds a number to the nearest integer.
Sgn(number)Returns the sign of a number: -1, 0 or 1.
Sin(number)Returns the sine of an angle given in radians.
Sqr(number)Returns the square root of a number.
Tan(number)Returns the tangent of an angle given in radians.

Query functions

QueryAddColumn(query, column_name, array_name)Adds a column to a query and fills it from an array.
QueryAddRow(query [, number ])Adds empty rows to a query.
QueryNew(columnlist)Creates an empty query with the given columns.
QuerySetCell(query, column_name, value [, row_number ])Sets the value of one cell in a query.
QuotedValueList(query.column [, delimiter ])Returns all values of a query column as a list of quoted strings.
ValueList(query.column [, delimiter ])Returns all values of a query column as a list.

String functions

Asc(string)Returns the ASCII code of the first character of a string.
Chr(number)Returns the character for an ASCII code.
CJustify(string, length)Centers a string in a field of a given width.
Compare(string1, string2)Compares two strings, case-sensitively.
CompareNoCase(string1, string2)Compares two strings, ignoring case.
Decrypt(encrypted_string, key)Decrypts a string that was encrypted with Encrypt.
Encrypt(string, key)Encrypts a string with a key.
Find(substring, string [, start ])Finds the first occurrence of a substring, case-sensitively.
FindNoCase(substring, string [, start ])Finds the first occurrence of a substring, ignoring case.
FindOneOf(set, string [, start ])Finds the first occurrence of any character from a set.
GetToken(string, index [, delimiters ])Returns the nth token of a string, given a set of delimiters.
Hash(string)Returns a one-way MD5 hash of a string.
Insert(substring, string, position)Inserts a substring into a string after a given position.
JSStringFormat(string)Escapes a string for use inside a JavaScript string literal.
LCase(string)Converts a string to lowercase.
Left(string, count)Returns the leftmost characters of a string.
Len(string_or_binary)Returns the length of a string or binary object.
LJustify(string, length)Left-justifies a string in a field of a given width.
LTrim(string)Removes leading spaces from a string.
Mid(string, start, count)Returns characters from the middle of a string.
REFind(reg_expression, string [, start ] [, returnsubexpressions ])Searches a string with a regular expression, case-sensitively.
REFindNoCase(reg_expression, string [, start ] [, returnsubexpressions ])Searches a string with a regular expression, ignoring case.
RemoveChars(string, start, count)Removes characters from a string.
RepeatString(string, count)Returns a string repeated a given number of times.
Replace(string, substring1, substring2 [, scope ])Replaces occurrences of a substring, case-sensitively.
ReplaceList(string, list1, list2)Replaces each item of one list with the matching item of another.
ReplaceNoCase(string, substring1, substring2 [, scope ])Replaces occurrences of a substring, ignoring case.
REReplace(string, reg_expression, substring [, scope ])Replaces text matching a regular expression, case-sensitively.
REReplaceNoCase(string, reg_expression, substring [, scope ])Replaces text matching a regular expression, ignoring case.
Reverse(string)Reverses the order of the characters in a string.
Right(string, count)Returns the rightmost characters of a string.
RJustify(string, length)Right-justifies a string in a field of a given width.
RTrim(string)Removes trailing spaces from a string.
SpanExcluding(string, set)Returns the characters at the start of a string up to the first character from a set.
SpanIncluding(string, set)Returns the characters at the start of a string that all belong to a set.
StripCR(string)Removes carriage-return characters from a string.
ToBase64(string_or_binary)Encodes a string or binary object in Base64.
ToBinary(base64_or_binary)Decodes a Base64 string into a binary object.
ToString(value)Converts a value, including a binary object, to a string.
Trim(string)Removes leading and trailing spaces from a string.
UCase(string)Converts a string to uppercase.
URLDecode(urlEncodedString)Decodes a URL-encoded string.
URLEncodedFormat(string)Encodes a string for safe use in a URL.
Val(string)Converts the number at the beginning of a string to a number.
Wrap(string, limit [, strip ])Wraps text so no line is longer than a given width.
XMLFormat(string)Escapes a string for use in XML text.

Structure functions

Duplicate(variable)Returns a complete, independent copy of any variable.
StructAppend(struct1, struct2 [, overwriteFlag ])Copies all keys of one structure into another.
StructClear(structure)Removes all keys from a structure.
StructCopy(structure)Makes a shallow copy of a structure.
StructCount(structure)Returns the number of keys in a structure.
StructDelete(structure, key [, indicatenotexisting ])Removes a key from a structure.
StructFind(structure, key)Returns the value stored under a key.
StructGet(pathDesired)Returns a structure at a variable path, creating it if needed.
StructInsert(structure, key, value [, allowoverwrite ])Adds a key-value pair to a structure.
StructIsEmpty(structure)Determines whether a structure has no keys.
StructKeyArray(structure)Returns the keys of a structure as an array.
StructKeyExists(structure, key)Determines whether a structure contains a key.
StructKeyList(structure [, delimiter ])Returns the keys of a structure as a list.
StructNew()Creates a new, empty structure.
StructUpdate(structure, key, value)Changes the value of an existing key.

System functions

CreateObject("COM", class [, context [, servername ] ])
CreateObject("CORBA", context, class [, locale ])
CreateObject("JAVA", class)		Creates a COM, CORBA or Java object (not available in KoldFusion for UNIX).
DeleteClientVariable("name")Deletes a client variable for the current visitor.
DirectoryExists(absolute_path)Returns YES if a directory exists on the server.
ExpandPath(relative_path)Turns a relative or URL-style path into an absolute file system path.
FileExists(absolute_path)Returns YES if a file exists on the server.
GetBaseTagData(tagname [, instancenumber ])Returns the data of an ancestor custom tag, from inside a nested custom tag.
GetBaseTagList()Returns a comma-delimited list of the custom tags that enclose the current one.
GetBaseTemplatePath()Returns the full path of the page that was requested.
GetClientVariablesList()Returns a list of the client variables you can change for the current visitor.
GetCurrentTemplatePath()Returns the full path of the template that contains the call.
GetDirectoryFromPath(path)Extracts the directory part of an absolute path.
GetFileFromPath(path)Extracts the file name from an absolute path.
GetFunctionList()Returns a structure whose keys are the names of all built-in CFML functions.
GetMetricData("PERF_MONITOR")Returns server performance counters in a structure.
GetProfileString(iniPath, section, entry)Reads one entry from a Windows-style initialization (.ini) file.
GetTempDirectory()Returns the path of the server's directory for temporary files.
GetTempFile(directory, prefix)Creates an empty file with a unique name and returns its path.
GetTemplatePath()Older name for GetBaseTemplatePath.
GetTickCount()Returns a millisecond counter for timing code.
JavaCast(type, variable)Marks a value with a Java type for calls to overloaded Java methods.
SetProfileString(iniPath, section, entry, value)Writes one entry to a Windows-style initialization (.ini) file.

Other functions

CreateUUID()Returns a new Universally Unique Identifier as a 35-character string.
KFUSION_CHECKSYNTAX(code [, name ])KoldFusion extension: checks a piece of CFML for syntax errors without running it.
PreserveSingleQuotes(variable)Stops CFQUERY from escaping the single quotes in a variable.
WriteOutput(string)Writes text to the page from inside CFSCRIPT.

Operators

KindOperators (highest precedence first)
Arithmetic+ - (unary) ^ * / \ MOD + -
String& (concatenation)
ComparisonIS, EQ, EQUAL · IS NOT, NEQ, NOT EQUAL · GT, GREATER THAN · LT, LESS THAN · GTE, GE, GREATER THAN OR EQUAL TO · LTE, LE, LESS THAN OR EQUAL TO · CONTAINS · DOES NOT CONTAIN
BooleanNOT AND OR XOR EQV IMP

Inside CFSCRIPT KoldFusion also accepts == != < > <= >= && || ! ++ -- += -= as a convenience.
